mapper.select:
SELECT FROM cms_media m
(m.original_filename ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR COALESCE(m.title, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%'))
AND m.file_type = #{fileType}
AND m.status = #{status}
ORDER BY m.uploaded_at
ASC DESC , m.id
ASC DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cms_media WHERE file_type = #{fileType}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cms_media (original_filename, stored_filename, file_url, file_type, file_size, title, description, alt_text, tags, status) VALUES (#{originalFilename}, #{storedFilename}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{title}, #{description}, #{altText}, #{tags}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM cms_media m WHERE m.id = #{id}

SELECT 'POST' AS usage_type, '게시글' AS target_type_label, p.id AS target_id, p.title AS target_title, p.slug AS target_slug, p.status AS target_status, CONCAT('/posts/', p.id, '/edit') AS target_url FROM cms_post p WHERE p.content ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{storedFilename}, '%') UNION ALL SELECT 'PAGE' AS usage_type, '페이지' AS target_type_label, pg.id AS target_id, pg.title AS target_title, pg.slug AS target_slug, pg.status AS target_status, CONCAT('/pages/', pg.id, '/edit') AS target_url FROM cms_page pg WHERE pg.content ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{storedFilename}, '%')
